reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (touchdown_stability_bonus, controlled_descent_bonus) off-pad. This revision converts these bonuses to one-shot event-gated rewards that trigger only once when the condition is first met. This prevents farming while still providing guidance. The distance penalty is increased slightly from -0.05 to -0.06 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad without being too aggressive (failed pattern from iter_004 used -0.1, iter_005->006 used -0.08, iter_006->007 used -0.07). The controlled_descent_bonus becomes a one-shot bonus that triggers when the lander first enters the near-pad zone (distance<0.3) with controlled descent (m_power>0, |angle|<0.2). The touchdown_stability_bonus becomes a one-shot bonus that triggers when both legs contact near the pad (distance<0.3) with low velocity (|vy|<0.5, |vx|<0.5, |angle|<0.2). A new one-shot 'reached_near_pad_bonus' (+20) is added to reward the lander for first entering the near-pad zone (distance<0.3), providing a clear milestone. The success condition is kept the same (both legs contact, |x|<0.15, |y|<0.15, |vy|<0.5).
preserved_design: velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
progress_shaping (distance and angle penalties) but with slightly increased distance scale
changed_design: Convert controlled_descent_bonus from repeatable (+0.5 per step) to one-shot (+5.0) that triggers only once when the lander first enters the near-pad zone (distance<0.3) with controlled descent (m_power>0, |angle|<0.2). Use self._controlled_descent_given flag to ensure one-shot.

Convert touchdown_stability_bonus from repeatable (+10 per step) to one-shot (+20) that triggers only once when both legs contact near the pad (distance<0.3) with low velocity (|vy|<0.5, |vx|<0.5, |angle|<0.2). Use self._touchdown_stability_given flag to ensure one-shot.

Add reached_near_pad_bonus: +20 one-shot bonus when the lander first enters the near-pad zone (distance<0.3). Use self._reached_near_pad flag to ensure one-shot. This provides a clear milestone reward for approaching the pad.
Increase progress_shaping distance penalty scale from -0.05 to -0.06 to provide a slightly stronger gradient toward the pad without being too aggressive (failed patterns used -0.07, -0.08, -0.1).
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make bonuses repeatable (failed pattern from iter_001): bonuses are now one-shot event-gated.
Do not increase distance penalty too aggressively (failed pattern from iter_004, iter_005->006, iter_006->007): increase from -0.05 to -0.06 only.
Do not add distance_improvement_bonus with self._prev_distance (failed pattern from iter_006->007): not added.
Do not tighten distance conditions to <0.1 (failed pattern from iter_005->006): use <0.3 for near-pad zone.
Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: bonuses are conditioned on progress and one-shot.
action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The one-shot bonuses will encourage the policy to use orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad to trigger the reached_near_pad_bonus. The increased distance penalty will encourage more main engine use (action 2) to descend faster toward the pad. The one-shot nature prevents farming.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): increased distance penalty (-0.06 * distance) provides a stronger gradient to move toward the pad. The reached_near_pad_bonus (+20) provides a clear milestone when the lander first enters the near-pad zone (distance<0.3). Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus (+5 one-shot) rewards the first controlled descent near the pad. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus (+20 one-shot) rewards the first stable touchdown near the pad. Success bonus (+100) provides final sparse signal.
payment_mode_plan: All positive bonuses are one-shot event-gated: reached_near_pad_bonus (first time distance<0.3), controlled_descent_bonus (first time distance<0.3 with m_power>0 and |angle|<0.2), touchdown_stability_bonus (first time both legs contact near pad with low velocity), objective_success_bonus (success condition). All penalties are per-step: progress_shaping, velocity_penalty, fuel_penalty, crash_penalty (terminal). This prevents farming and ensures the policy must progress through phases to collect rewards.
